article.title: France: State brutality and media lies fail to break students’ resolve as workers mobilise in support of the revolt
article.author: John Mullen
article.content: Despite the barbarous attempts at repressing the student protests, more than a quarter of a million students continue to protest on the streets and from the barricades. Paris resident, John Mullen, reports on the explosion of widespread anger that has swept the country. The post France: State brutality and media lies fail to break students’ resolve as workers mobilise in support of the revolt appeared first on MR Online .
